integrity: Analytic Fourier-inversion proof covers arbitrary finite hosts; executable exact finite checks were performed; external independent validation is absent.
scientific_limitations: Assumes labelled simple host, independent identically parameterized percolation in paired samples, each present probability in (0,1); polynomial sample guarantee additionally assumes known positive epsilon. Unknown edge probability recovery and unaligned samples are not claimed; prior-work search is necessarily bounded.
title: Binary degree-agreement covariance identifies every edge of an unknown percolation host
